templates.title: Ownership
templates.question: who owns this cloud ID, and which other sources know the same object

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The resource: a name, an IR id, a block address or a cloud ID.

query.text: MATCH (r:Resource {key: $key}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:KNOWN_AS]->(:CloudId)<-[:KNOWN_AS]-(o:Resource) WHERE o.key <> r.key RETURN r.key AS key, r.ownership AS ownership, r.facts AS facts, r.observedAt AS observedAt, collect(DISTINCT o.key) AS sameObject

templates.note: An engine's ownership is bound, unowned, pending or foreign; absent is unknown, never guessed. A cloud listing reads markers only.

query.text: MATCH (o:Resource)-[e:REF]->(r:Resource {key: $key}) WHERE o.scopeKey <> r.scopeKey RETURN o.key AS key, o.scopeKey AS scope, e.viaAttr AS via, e.origin AS origin, e.rule AS rule UNION MATCH (r:Resource {key: $key})-[:KNOWN_AS]->(:CloudId)<-[:KNOWN_AS]-(t:Resource)<-[e:REF]-(o:Resource) WHERE o.scopeKey <> r.scopeKey RETURN o.key AS key, o.scopeKey AS scope, e.viaAttr AS via, e.origin AS origin, e.rule AS rule

templates.note: A derived edge (origin derived, rule identity:<kind>) is an identity match, not a declared reference.
